item.title: Airstrike on Karenni Detention Center Kills Five, Including Child
item.description: An airstrike carried out by the military junta on Detention Center No. 2 in Karenni State killed five people, including women and a child, according to local authorities. The attack occurred on March 5 at around 11:00 a.m., when a military aircraft reportedly dropped three bombs on the detention facility.
